paragraphs: Markets over the last day: the eight tracked equity indices moved +0.85% on average, with Nikkei 225 strongest (+4.74%) and DAX weakest (-1.92%). Brent crude changed -6.07% to 92.35. Gold changed +1.78% to 4,147.2998. Bitcoin changed +0.62% to 75,048.2734. The US 10-year yield stands at 4.864%, a relative move of +0.10%. Among the firms tracked, Invesco (+6.76%) and Carlyle (+6.57%) moved the most.
